hook: Ethiopia says the Ark of the Covenant is in Aksum.

verse.translation: Arise, Yahweh, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength.

story: The Ark of the Covenant held the stone tablets Moses carried down from Sinai. For Israel, it was the sign that God lived among His people.

The Kebra Nagast says Menelik, son of Solomon and the Queen of Sheba, brought the Ark to Ethiopia. Tradition holds it's kept at the Church of St. Mary of Zion in Aksum, and every Ethiopian Orthodox church has a tabot that represents it.
Today is Hidar 21, Hidar Tsion. Pilgrims fill Aksum for one of the biggest feasts of the year, right in the middle of this fast.
meaning: The church calls Mary the true Ark: the Ark carried God's word written on stone, and Mary carried the Word of God made flesh. That's why this feast belongs in the season before Genna.

sources.title: Psalm 132:8 and Exodus 25:16, World English Bible (public domain)
Kebra Nagast (The Glory of the Kings), Ethiopian tradition compiled in the 1300s

review.notes: Check with Memhir Senay which event Hidar 21 itself commemorates, and how the fast is kept on the feast day.
